title: GEMglIsTexture
description: determine if a name corresponds to a texture

messages.description: value that may be the name of a texture
1 if the ID is a texture, 0 if not

arguments.description: value that may be the name of a texture

body: [GEMglIsTexture] calls glIsTexture() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glIsTexture in the OpenGL reference.
